title: Laptop cannot join corporate Wi-Fi
steps: Check the device certificate has not expired (Settings > Certificates).
Confirm the time and date are correct; 802.1x fails on clock drift.
If it still fails, collect the controller log for the device MAC and escalate to Network.

title: Reset a locked account or password
steps: Verify the caller's identity using the standard checklist.
Unlock the account in the directory console.
Issue a temporary password and require a change at next sign-in.

title: VPN connects but internal sites do not load
steps: Check the VPN profile pushes the internal DNS suffix.
Run nslookup for an internal hostname against the internal resolver.
If DNS answers but HTTP fails, test the route with a traceroute to the app subnet.

title: Printer shows offline
steps: Ping the printer address and check the web panel.
Clear the print queue and restart the spooler service.
Remove and re-add the printer using its hostname, not the IP.

title: Website reachable for some users but not others
steps: Compare DNS answers from two resolvers; stale caches show up as different IPs.
Check the HTTP status and redirect chain with curl -I.
Look at upstream health and recent deploys before blaming the client.
